item.title: Pope Leo Calls Putin, Urges Humanitarian Truce in Ukraine
item.description: Pope Leo XIV spoke with Russian President Vladimir Putin on Friday, calling for a ceasefire to allow humanitarian aid into a Russian-occupied area of Ukraine.
